trial_court: Court of Ld. Principal Judge (Family Court), Shimla bearing HMA No.179-S/3 of 2023
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Marriage was solemnized on 14.08.2012. Respondent turned out petitioner from his matrimonial home. Petitioner is residing at her parental house and has filed a petition under Domestic Violence Act, claiming maintenance.

legal_principles.principle: Convenience of the wife is to be preferred over convenience of the husband in matrimonial matters.
legal_principles.held: In this type of matter, the convenience of the wife is to be preferred over the convenience of the husband.
cited_cases: Rajani Kishor Pardeshi Versus Kishor Babulal Pardeshi (2005) 12 SCC 237

legal_principles.principle: In matrimonial matters, the Courts have to take into consideration the economic soundness of both parties, social strata of spouses and their behavioural pattern.
legal_principles.held: The Courts have to take into consideration the economic soundness of both the parties, the social strata of the spouses and their behavioural pattern.
cited_cases: N.C.V. Aishwarya versus A.S. Saravana Karthik Sha

outcome.final_order: Proceedings i.e. HMA No.179-S/3 of 2023 may be transferred to the Court of Ld. Principal Judge (Family Court) Mandi, District Mandi, H.P.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
